name: Marinated Vegetable Salad
description: A colorful and versatile marinated vegetable salad perfect for serving as finger food or a side dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and clean all the vegetables, then drain well.
Break cauliflower and broccoli into bite-sized pieces.
Trim radishes and carrots; leave whole unless large, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Cut celery into 3-inch pieces and slice cucumber into 1/2-inch slices.
Leave cherry tomatoes whole.
Place all prepared vegetables in a large bowl.
Pour Italian dressing over the vegetables and let set for a few hours.
Serve as finger food or as a salad.

keywords: marinated vegetables, vegetable salad, Italian dressing

_similar.name: Pasta Salad
_similar.description: A colorful pasta salad with penne or spiral pasta, vegetables, feta cheese, and a tangy herb dressing.
recipeIngredient: ½ bag penne or spiral pasta

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the pasta according to package instructions, then drain and cool.
Add chopped green pepper, tomatoes, green onions, and sliced black olives to the cooled pasta.
Crumble the feta cheese into the pasta mixture.
Pour the Classic Herb dressing over the salad and toss to combine.

_similar.keywords: pasta salad, feta cheese, herb dressing, vegetable salad

_similar.name: Onion Salad
_similar.description: A simple onion salad marinated in a sweet and tangy dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Marinate the thinly sliced onions with salt, sugar, water, and vinegar overnight.
Drain the marinade well in the morning.
Add mayonnaise (or salad dressing) and celery seed to the drained onions.
Chill until ready to serve.

_similar.keywords: onion salad, marinated onions, sweet and tangy salad

_similar.name: Layered Coleslaw Salad
_similar.description: A layered coleslaw salad with shredded carrots, snow peas, and a creamy Miracle Whip dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (8.5 oz) Oriental flavor dry noodles

recipeInstructions.text: Shred cabbage and place in bottom of large glass bowl. Top with remaining ingredients in order given.

_similar.name: Taco Salad
_similar.description: A hearty taco salad with seasoned ground beef, lettuce, cheese, and crushed taco chips, mixed with Catalina dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 (250 g) bag cheese taco chips, crushed

recipeInstructions.text: Cook ground beef until crumbly, drain off fat, and season with taco seasoning mix.
Refrigerate the cooked beef until ready to use.
Toss together the cooled beef, chopped lettuce, crushed taco chips, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Mix in Catalina dressing until well coated.
Carefully add in the chopped tomato.
Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: taco salad, ground beef, taco chips, Catalina dressing
